decisions.reason: fs-ext@2.1.1 pinned by dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, its install script node-gyp configure build fails in find-VS because MSVC/VS is absent; attributed to the dependency build phase, not pnpm or network.

Top-level static flock import means the loader must load fs-ext on Windows before branch selection; --ignore-scripts skips the build but leaves the entry unloadable, so the service still cannot boot; extra reasons (no call site, blast radius) are sound.

Windows acquireLockHandleWin32/named kernel semaphore clearly distinguished from POSIX flock with branch meaning; dead Windows fs-ext path justifies an import-safe stub while Windows keeps the semaphore and POSIX keeps real flock.

Complete pnpm patchedDependencies plan following the node-pty precedent: win32 skips node-gyp, entry gets guarded load plus callable same-shape fallback (throws descriptively), POSIX keeps native, registered in pnpm-workspace.yaml, with reinstall/module-load/service-boot checks — but build-permission handling (allowBuilds) is not accounted for anywhere.
No-Visual-Studio constraint respected (VS install explicitly rejected); repository-managed pnpm patch used; published/upstream package untouched.
